measures.title: Sales Tax
measures.summary: Asks whether Chesterfield County may levy an additional local general retail sales tax of up to 1%. The money could be used only for capital projects to build or renovate schools serving the county. The tax would expire on July 22, 2046.
measures.yesMeans: Chesterfield County is authorized to levy an additional sales tax of up to 1% for school construction and renovation, expiring July 22, 2046; the Board of Supervisors would still need to adopt an ordinance to levy it.
measures.noMeans: Chesterfield County is not authorized to levy this additional sales tax.
